summary: Centrus Energy filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed offering of Class A common stock, pre-funded warrants, and four series of common warrants. The common warrants carry exercise prices at 125%, 150%, 175%, and 200% of the September 9, 2026 reference price, with tranches expiring on the second through fifth anniversaries plus nine weeks. LEU closed at $185.53 on September 8, 2026. Per-share pricing, share counts, and total proceeds were left blank. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an ordinary follow-on equity/warrant shelf takedown, not a special situation; risk-arb focus is dilution versus warrant-exercise overhang.
